source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Each **TRANSPORT** model’s datasheet gives a transport capacity, which sets which friendly models may embark in it and how many. Several units may be embarked in one **TRANSPORT** model simultaneously, as long as its capacity allows. While declaring battle formations before the battle, your units may begin embarked in any friendly **TRANSPORT** model with enough capacity left for the entire unit. Every friendly **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** model needs a friendly unit embarked in it; once that step ends, any that has none is destroyed, without setting off any on-destruction rules.
